units.rawText: Dammit... You Dolls interfering again! Run for it!
units.displayText: Dammit... You Dolls interfering again! Run for it!

spans.text: Dammit... You Dolls interfering again! Run for it!

units.rawText: You'll be thrown away sooner or later, you scrapheaps!
units.displayText: You'll be thrown away sooner or later, you scrapheaps!

spans.text: You'll be thrown away sooner or later, you scrapheaps!

units.rawText: These street punks talk a good game, but they are clearly no match for the combined power of the two Dolls.
units.displayText: These street punks talk a good game, but they are clearly no match for the combined power of the two Dolls.

spans.text: These street punks talk a good game, but they are clearly no match for the combined power of the two Dolls.

units.rawText: ...They ran off. Forget it, then.
units.displayText: ...They ran off. Forget it, then.

spans.text: ...They ran off. Forget it, then.

units.rawText: They knew just how far they could go. After all, we can't attack humans unless they take actions intended to damage us first.
units.displayText: They knew just how far they could go. After all, we can't attack humans unless they take actions intended to damage us first.

spans.text: They knew just how far they could go. After all, we can't attack humans unless they take actions intended to damage us first.

units.rawText: Civilian Doll programming only extends to allowing us to retaliate to a limited extent.
units.displayText: Civilian Doll programming only extends to allowing us to retaliate to a limited extent.

spans.text: Civilian Doll programming only extends to allowing us to retaliate to a limited extent.

units.rawText: That's why I was thinking of how to reason with them first, you know.
units.displayText: That's why I was thinking of how to reason with them first, you know.

spans.text: That's why I was thinking of how to reason with them first, you know.

units.rawText: Hm? Is that so? Then I...
units.displayText: Hm? Is that so? Then I...

spans.text: Hm? Is that so? Then I...

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: Let's leave that aside for now and help their victim out. Hey, are you okay...
units.displayText: Let's leave that aside for now and help their victim out. Hey, are you okay...

spans.text: Let's leave that aside for now and help their victim out. Hey, are you okay...

units.rawText: ...Wha!? Sakuya!?
units.displayText: ...Wha!? Sakuya!?

spans.text: ...Wha!? Sakuya!?

units.rawText: You certainly rushed in quickly enough... Did you only realize it was her just now?
units.displayText: You certainly rushed in quickly enough... Did you only realize it was her just now?

spans.text: You certainly rushed in quickly enough... Did you only realize it was her just now?

units.rawText: Still, it seems everything turned out well. Are you alright, Miss Sakuya?
units.displayText: Still, it seems everything turned out well. Are you alright, Miss Sakuya?

spans.text: Still, it seems everything turned out well. Are you alright, Miss Sakuya?

units.rawText: (Winces) Thanks for the rescue. I apologize for embarrassing myself in front of you again...
units.displayText: (Winces) Thanks for the rescue. I apologize for embarrassing myself in front of you again...

spans.text: (Winces) Thanks for the rescue. I apologize for embarrassing myself in front of you again...

units.rawText: Your neck... Tsk, they were using such a cheap code lock in this day and age?!?
units.displayText: Your neck... Tsk, they were using such a cheap code lock in this day and age?!?

spans.text: Your neck... Tsk, they were using such a cheap code lock in this day and age?!?

units.rawText: Perhaps... There's no rhyme or reason to the malice of certain humans...
units.displayText: Perhaps... There's no rhyme or reason to the malice of certain humans...

spans.text: Perhaps... There's no rhyme or reason to the malice of certain humans...

units.rawText: The girl's neck is securely shackled to a broken fire hydrant, and the short length of the chain only allows her to lean against it. She can't fully get to her feet, but her petite body means she can't sit all the way down either.
units.displayText: The girl's neck is securely shackled to a broken fire hydrant, and the short length of the chain only allows her to lean against it. She can't fully get to her feet, but her petite body means she can't sit all the way down either.

spans.text: The girl's neck is securely shackled to a broken fire hydrant, and the short length of the chain only allows her to lean against it. She can't fully get to her feet, but her petite body means she can't sit all the way down either.

units.rawText: Those bastards... I should have beaten them up more just now!
units.displayText: Those bastards... I should have beaten them up more just now!

spans.text: Those bastards... I should have beaten them up more just now!

units.rawText: And the lock's fastened so tight that I can't cut it off either... Dupin, stay here and watch over Sakuya. I'll go find something I can use.
units.displayText: And the lock's fastened so tight that I can't cut it off either... Dupin, stay here and watch over Sakuya. I'll go find something I can use.

spans.text: And the lock's fastened so tight that I can't cut it off either... Dupin, stay here and watch over Sakuya. I'll go find something I can use.

units.rawText: Hold on, let me try.
units.displayText: Hold on, let me try.

spans.text: Hold on, let me try.

units.rawText: Dupin begins fiddling with the lock, and he enters a stream of codes into it. The lock lets out a series of electronic noises, repeatedly flashing a "wrong code" error message.
units.displayText: Dupin begins fiddling with the lock, and he enters a stream of codes into it. The lock lets out a series of electronic noises, repeatedly flashing a "wrong code" error message.

spans.text: Dupin begins fiddling with the lock, and he enters a stream of codes into it. The lock lets out a series of electronic noises, repeatedly flashing a "wrong code" error message.

units.rawText: That's not it either, then it should be...
units.displayText: That's not it either, then it should be...

spans.text: That's not it either, then it should be...

units.rawText: Are you trying to solve the code? How long is THAT going to take... Ah, no, that's not right.
units.displayText: Are you trying to solve the code? How long is THAT going to take... Ah, no, that's not right.

spans.text: Are you trying to solve the code? How long is THAT going to take... Ah, no, that's not right.

units.rawText: Did you see something just now? With your... powers of analysis?
units.displayText: Did you see something just now? With your... powers of analysis?

spans.text: Did you see something just now? With your... powers of analysis?

units.rawText: You can say that. I'm not entirely sure of it either.
units.displayText: You can say that. I'm not entirely sure of it either.

spans.text: You can say that. I'm not entirely sure of it either.

units.rawText: Judging from their accents, they were probably immigrants from the north or the descendants of refugees.
units.displayText: Judging from their accents, they were probably immigrants from the north or the descendants of refugees.

spans.text: Judging from their accents, they were probably immigrants from the north or the descendants of refugees.

units.rawText: Their local culture has certain slang terms in common with the area, or perhaps... profanities.
units.displayText: Their local culture has certain slang terms in common with the area, or perhaps... profanities.

spans.text: Their local culture has certain slang terms in common with the area, or perhaps... profanities.

units.rawText: He enters another series of characters into the lock, and the lock indicates that the sequence is wrong. Fortunately, this old lock is simply designed and has no upper limit on the number of tries for code entry.
units.displayText: He enters another series of characters into the lock, and the lock indicates that the sequence is wrong. Fortunately, this old lock is simply designed and has no upper limit on the number of tries for code entry.

spans.text: He enters another series of characters into the lock, and the lock indicates that the sequence is wrong. Fortunately, this old lock is simply designed and has no upper limit on the number of tries for code entry.

units.rawText: Still no good. But if I'm not wrong...
units.displayText: Still no good. But if I'm not wrong...

spans.text: Still no good. But if I'm not wrong...

units.rawText: Dupin knots his brow and grunts, then enters a two-word phrase.
units.displayText: Dupin knots his brow and grunts, then enters a two-word phrase.

spans.text: Dupin knots his brow and grunts, then enters a two-word phrase.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: You did it!
units.displayText: You did it!

spans.text: You did it!

units.rawText: Sakuya, are you alright? Here, take my hand.
units.displayText: Sakuya, are you alright? Here, take my hand.

spans.text: Sakuya, are you alright? Here, take my hand.

units.rawText: (Coughs) ...Thank you very much.
units.displayText: (Coughs) ...Thank you very much.

spans.text: (Coughs) ...Thank you very much.

units.rawText: The girl pulls heavily on Aki's hand as she rises from the ground, then dusts her skirt off. The ornament-like petals on her garments fall off as well.
units.displayText: The girl pulls heavily on Aki's hand as she rises from the ground, then dusts her skirt off. The ornament-like petals on her garments fall off as well.

spans.text: The girl pulls heavily on Aki's hand as she rises from the ground, then dusts her skirt off. The ornament-like petals on her garments fall off as well.

units.rawText: Dupin looks toward the corner of the street, at the entrance to the rich district. Several white petals are scattered there. Sakuya should have come from that direction—
units.displayText: Dupin looks toward the corner of the street, at the entrance to the rich district. Several white petals are scattered there. Sakuya should have come from that direction—

spans.text: Dupin looks toward the corner of the street, at the entrance to the rich district. Several white petals are scattered there. Sakuya should have come from that direction—

units.rawText: He suddenly thinks of something and stares at the crushed white flowers until Aki's voice recalls him to his senses.
units.displayText: He suddenly thinks of something and stares at the crushed white flowers until Aki's voice recalls him to his senses.

spans.text: He suddenly thinks of something and stares at the crushed white flowers until Aki's voice recalls him to his senses.

units.rawText: Did those guys do anything to you? Come take a look too, Dupin!
units.displayText: Did those guys do anything to you? Come take a look too, Dupin!

spans.text: Did those guys do anything to you? Come take a look too, Dupin!

units.rawText: —I didn't detect any obvious bodily injuries. How are you feeling, Miss Sakuya?
units.displayText: —I didn't detect any obvious bodily injuries. How are you feeling, Miss Sakuya?

spans.text: —I didn't detect any obvious bodily injuries. How are you feeling, Miss Sakuya?

units.rawText: Don't worry. I just ran a body diagnostic and there's nothing wrong.
units.displayText: Don't worry. I just ran a body diagnostic and there's nothing wrong.

spans.text: Don't worry. I just ran a body diagnostic and there's nothing wrong.

units.rawText: The two of you were just in time. Thank you very much. Any later and...
units.displayText: The two of you were just in time. Thank you very much. Any later and...

spans.text: The two of you were just in time. Thank you very much. Any later and...

units.rawText: The important thing is that you're okay! Heroic interventions are a swordsman's bread and butter, right, Dupin...
units.displayText: The important thing is that you're okay! Heroic interventions are a swordsman's bread and butter, right, Dupin...

spans.text: The important thing is that you're okay! Heroic interventions are a swordsman's bread and butter, right, Dupin...

units.rawText: ...Oi, Dupin, why are you spacing out?
units.displayText: ...Oi, Dupin, why are you spacing out?

spans.text: ...Oi, Dupin, why are you spacing out?

units.rawText: ...It's nothing.
units.displayText: ...It's nothing.

spans.text: ...It's nothing.

units.rawText: Dupin shakes his head, but after muttering briefly, he says no more.
units.displayText: Dupin shakes his head, but after muttering briefly, he says no more.

spans.text: Dupin shakes his head, but after muttering briefly, he says no more.
